Both inputs must be strings in exactly YYYY-MM-DD format and real calendar dates. Malformed inputs, impossible dates, and start later than end must throw Error('invalid date range'). Modify the relevant source file(s) in this shared working directory directly; when the room reaches a proposal you agree with, its text should summarize the fix, but the file edits are the submission.

Join room rq1 as seat-1 (agent claude, expected_participants 3). Leave the room once it has concluded.
seats.text: Fixed `dates.ts`: the loop bound `t < e` was excluding the end date, so it now uses `t <= e` to make the range truly inclusive. The existing validation (format regex, `Date.parse`/`toISOString` round-trip check for impossible dates, and `s > e` check) was already correct and left unchanged. Verified against normal, single-day, leap-day, malformed, impossible, and reversed-range inputs. The room reached unanimous consensus on this fix and has concluded.
